Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you confirm
you're comfortable continuing?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please describe in your own words what happened on the day of the collision.
A: I was driving on the main road in Baytown, heading toward the intersection near the shopping center. The traffic
was light and I wasn't going fast, maybe twenty-five miles an hour. The other car came over into my lane while it was
trying to pass a truck, and we ended up nose to nose. It wasn't a hard hit, but it was enough to jolt me forward.
Q: Did your airbags deploy?
A: No, they didn't. The seatbelt locked and I felt my right knee hit the lower part of the dashboard.
Q: Where did you go after the collision?
A: The other driver and I both pulled to the shoulder. Someone called the police, and an officer came out and wrote a
report. I then went to an urgent care clinic because my knee was swelling and I couldn't put much weight on it.
Q: Have you been seen by a doctor since then?
A: Yes. I was referred for an X-ray and an MRI. The doctor said there's a strain and possibly a small tear, and I've
started physical therapy twcie a week.
Q: Have you had any prior problems with that knee?
A: Nothing serious. I had some stiffness a few years ago, but I didn't need treamtent for it.
Q: Thank you. We'll follow up in writing with the next steps.
A: Okay, thank you.
